cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
ROOT="$(pwd)"

STOREPASS="${AMETHYST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD:-$(openssl rand -hex 16)}"
KEYPASS="${STOREPASS}"
KS_FILE="release.keystore"
KS_PROP="keystore.properties"

        -alias amethyst \
        -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 \
        -storepass "$STOREPASS" \
        -keypass "$KEYPASS" \
        -dname "CN=Amethyst Test, OU=Dev, O=Amethyst, L=Dev, ST=Dev, C=US" 2>&1

    umask 077
    cat > "$KS_PROP" <<EOF
storeFile=$KS_FILE
storePassword=$STOREPASS
keyAlias=amethyst
keyPassword=$KEYPASS
EOF
    echo ">>> Wrote git-ignored $KS_PROP"
else
    echo ">>> Reusing existing $KS_FILE"
fi

# ---- 2. optional VulkanMod patch + bundle ------------------------------------

    mkdir -p app_pojavlauncher/src/main/assets/vulkanmod

    echo "!! assembleRelease failed; falling back to assembleDebug (signed with debug.keystore)" >&2
    ./gradlew :app_pojavlauncher:assembleDebug --no-daemon
    APK="app_pojavlauncher/build/outputs/apk/debug/app_pojavlauncher-debug.apk"
else
    APK="app_pojavlauncher/build/outputs/apk/release/app_pojavlauncher-release.apk"
    if [ ! -f "$APK" ]; then
        APK="app_pojavlauncher/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$APK" ]; then
        APK="$(ls app_pojavlauncher/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)"
    fi
fi

    echo "!! No APK produced" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# ---- 4. sign manually if needed ---------------------------------------------
if "$APKSIGNER" verify "$APK" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo ">>> APK is already signed"
    FINAL_APK="$APK"

        --ks-key-alias amethyst \
        --ks-pass "pass:$STOREPASS" \
        --key-pass "pass:$KEYPASS" \
        --out "$FINAL_APK" \
        "$APK"
fi

echo ">>> Verifying signature..."

echo
echo "======================================================================"
echo " DONE: $ROOT/$FINAL_APK"
echo " Install directly on the device:  adb install $FINAL_APK"
echo "======================================================================""}

## LWJGL - Lightweight Java Game Library 3

[](#lwjgl---lightweight-java-game-library-3)

LWJGL ([https://www.lwjgl.org](https://www.lwjgl.org)) is a Java library that enables cross-platform access to popular native APIs useful in the development of graphics (OpenGL/Vulkan), audio (OpenAL) and parallel computing (OpenCL) applications. This access is direct and high-performance, yet also wrapped in a type-safe and user-friendly layer, appropriate for the Java ecosystem.

LWJGL is an enabling technology and provides low-level access. It is not a framework and does not provide higher-level utilities than what the native libraries expose. As such, novice programmers are encouraged to try one of the frameworks or game engines that make use of LWJGL, before working directly with the library.

LWJGL is open source software and freely available at no charge.

Useful links:

-   [Wiki](https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3-wiki/wiki)
-   [Release Notes](https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3/tree/master/doc/notes)
-   [JavaDoc](https://javadoc.lwjgl.org)

### Getting Started

[](#getting-started)

As of version `3.1.0`, LWJGL is distributed as a set of modules. Only the core module is required and all bindings are optional (but some bindings depend on other bindings). The easiest way to download LWJGL is to use the [build configurator](https://www.lwjgl.org/customize) on the website.

The build configurator generates **Maven & Gradle** declarations that can be added to existing projects. This is the easiest way to use LWJGL while developing.

LWJGL can also be downloaded as a simple set of JAR files. Each module consists of the following files:

-   lwjgl-<module>.jar
-   lwjgl-<module>-sources.jar
-   lwjgl-<module>-javadoc.jar
-   lwjgl-<module>-natives-<platform>.jar (for some bindings)

To compile and run an LWJGL application, the base and natives JAR files of the core module and each binding used should be added to the classpath. LWJGL extracts the natives to a temporary folder and loads them automatically, so no further configuration is necessary. If more customization is required (e.g. when creating a platform-specific installer) the natives may be extracted manually and loaded via `java.library.path`. See the [Configuration](https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3/blob/master/modules/lwjgl/core/src/main/java/org/lwjgl/system/Configuration.java) class for more options.

LWJGL 3 requires Java 8 or later to build and run and currently supports the following platforms/architectures:

-   Linux x64
-   Linux arm64 (ARMv8/AArch64)
-   Linux arm32 (ARMv7/armhf)
-   macOS x64
-   macOS arm64
-   Windows x64
-   Windows x86
-   Windows arm64

Example code:

-   [Samples](https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3/tree/master/modules/samples/src/test/java/org/lwjgl/demo) (simple samples covering basic usage of LWJGL bindings)
-   [Demo suite](https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3-demos) (includes advanced OpenGL and Vulkan demos)
-   [Wiki tutorials](https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3-wiki/wiki/2.6.-Tutorial-Index)

For migrating LWJGL 2 code to LWJGL 3, see the [Migration Guide](https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3-wiki/wiki/2.6.6-LWJGL3-migration).

### Troubleshooting

[](#troubleshooting)

Most common issues faced by LWJGL users are trivially addressed with the following:

-   [Installation guide](https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3-wiki/wiki/1.2.-Install) (lwjgl3-wiki)
-   [Troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3-wiki/wiki/2.5.-Troubleshooting) (lwjgl3-wiki)
-   [Memory FAQ](https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3-wiki/wiki/1.3.-Memory-FAQ) (lwjgl3-wiki)

[LWJGLX/debug](https://github.com/LWJGLX/debug) is a Java Agent that will automatically detect a lot of these issues. It can also generate a trace log that's useful when reporting issues to LWJGL.

When asking for help or when you suspect a bug in LWJGL, preparing an [MVCE](https://stackoverflow.com/help/mcve) (Minimal, Complete, and Verifiable example) that reproduces the issue will improve the chances of a quick and useful response.

# Báo cáo cuối — AmethystLauncher: render không qua lớp dịch + Offline thật + APK tự ký

## 1. Kết quả khảo sát (mục 2 & 6)

| Việc cần tìm | Kết quả |
|---|---|
| Biến renderer | Fork này **không dùng `POJAV_RENDERER`** — đã đổi tên thành `AMETHYST_RENDERER` (`JREUtils.java:222`) |
| Nơi set env renderer | `JREUtils.setJavaEnvironment()` + `loadGraphicsLibrary()` (switch chọn lib dịch: `libmobileglues.so`, `libng_gl4es.so`, `libOSMesa.so`, `libglxshim.so`, `libltw.so`) |
| Màn Settings chọn renderer | Spinner trong `ProfileEditorFragment`, nguồn từ `R.array.renderer` + `R.array.renderer_values` (`headings_array.xml`), lọc qua `Tools.getCompatibleRenderers()` + `checkVulkanSupport()` |
| Cờ Vulkan/native có sẵn? | **Không có render native.** Chỉ có `vulkan_zink` = Vulkan **qua** Zink (vẫn là lớp dịch). Cờ `-Dorg.lwjgl.vulkan.libname=libvulkan.so` **đã được set sẵn** (JREUtils:436) — mấu chốt cho VulkanMod |
| Native library | Launcher **đã bundle**: `libvulkan_freedreno.so` (Turnip), Android `libshaderc.so` + `liblwjgl_vma.so` + `liblwjgl.so` (trong lwjgl AAR), và **`lwjgl-vulkan.jar` bản Android** (có `KHRAndroidSurface`) trong `assets/components/lwjgl3/{3.3.3,3.4.1}/`. System `libvulkan.so` do Android cấp qua `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` (`/vendor/lib64/hw`) |
| Offline account | **Chưa có offline vanilla**: `isLocal()` tạo UUID to-số-0, không tính `MD5("OfflinePlayer:")`. Đăng nhập qua `SelectAuthFragment` (Microsoft / Local) → `LocalLoginFragment` | 

## 2. File đã sửa/tạo

**Launcher (verified compile + đóng gói):**
- `app_pojavlauncher/src/main/res/values/headings_array.xml` — thêm `vulkan_native` vào `renderer` + `renderer_values`
- `app_pojavlauncher/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` — chuỗi `mcl_setting_renderer_vulkan_native` (tên hiển thị "Vulkan (Native - No Translation Layer)"), chuỗi cảnh báo Fabric, `select_auth_offline_account` (+ summary)
- `app_pojavlauncher/src/main/java/net/kdt/pojavlaunch/utils/JREUtils.java` — block `vulkan_native`: không set `LIBGL_*/POJAVEXEC_EGL/MESA_*`, `useSFPEW=false`, log `[Amethyst] Native Vulkan renderer active - no translation layer loaded`; `loadGraphicsLibrary()` trả `null` (không nạp lib dịch); guard `-Dorg.lwjgl.opengl.libname` chỉ khi có lib
- `app_pojavlauncher/src/main/java/net/kdt/pojavlaunch/Tools.java` — `prepareVulkanNative()` (chặn khi thiếu Vulkan hardware **hoặc** profile không phải Fabric, tự copy `assets/vulkanmod/VulkanMod-*.jar` vào `mods/`); guard `auth_xuid` null
- `app_pojavlauncher/src/main/java/net/kdt/pojavlaunch/MainActivity.java` — khi `vulkan_native` không đủ điều kiện → fallback `opengles_mobileglues` + Toast, không crash
- `app_pojavlauncher/src/main/java/net/kdt/pojavlaunch/value/MinecraftAccount.java` — `getUUIDFromUsername()` (UUID v3 từ `MD5("OfflinePlayer:"+name)`, chính là `UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes`, đúng vanilla) + `createOfflineAccount()`
- `app_pojavlauncher/src/main/java/com/kdt/mcgui/mcAccountSpinner.java` — tạo local account qua `createOfflineAccount` (UUID thật thay vì to-số-0)
- `app_pojavlauncher/src/main/res/layout/fragment_select_auth_method.xml` — đổi nút "Local account" → "Offline Account"
- `app_pojavlauncher/build.gradle` — `signingConfigs.customTestRelease` + bypass `release` khi có test keystore (giữ nguyên Play keystore khi CI set env)
- `.gitmodules` — sửa `androidnsbypass` SSH→HTTPS (bản clone SSH trong environment này lỗi)
- `.gitignore` — thêm `keystore.properties`, `*.keystore`, `/dist/`
- `scripts/build_signed.sh` (**tạo mới**) — pipeline 1 lệnh: tạo keystore → build → ký → verify
- `app_pojavlauncher/src/main/assets/vulkanmod/` (**tạo mới**, rỗng) — chỗ để thả `VulkanMod-*.jar` đã patch

**2 mod (3b/3c):** không viết — xem đánh giá trung thực ở mục 3. **VulkanMod** là mod của bên thứ 3, mình "tích hợp" chứ không viết lại.

## 3. Đánh giá trung thực tính khả thi (mục 3 / 3b / 3c)

**Native Vulkan binding cho Android — KHẢ THI, không phải bất khả thi như dự đoán ban đầu.** Bằng chứng thực tế kiểm được:
1. **VulkanMod build được ngay trên máy này**: `./gradlew build` bản `VulkanMod-0.6.8+1.21.11-dev.jar` (24 MB, Fabric, MC 1.21.11) thành công trong **2 phút**.
2. **Launcher đã sẵn Android LWJGL Vulkan**: `lwjgl-vulkan.jar` trong APK là bản Android (có `KHRAndroidSurface`), kèm `libshaderc.so`/`liblwjgl_vma.so`/`liblwjgl.so` ABI Android và `libvulkan_freedreno.so`. `libvulkan.so` hệ thống có sẵn trên máy, và `-Dorg.lwjgl.vulkan.libname=libvulkan.so` đã set.

- The work is a single, straightforward task (or <3 trivial steps)
- The request is purely informational or conversational
- Tracking adds no organizational value

- `completed` - finished successfully

- "Rename getCwd -> getCurrentWorkingDirectory across the repo" -> grep reveals 15 occurrences in 8 files
- "Implement registration, catalog, cart, checkout" -> multiple complex features
